title: What's My Age Again?
lyrics:
[00:12.41]I took her out, it was a Friday night
[00:15.46]I wore cologne to get the feeling right
[00:18.39]We started making out and she took off my pants
[00:21.39]But then I turned on the TV
[00:23.99]And that's about the time she walked away from me
[00:27.43]Nobody likes you when you're twenty-three
[00:30.48]And are still more amused by TV shows
[00:33.25]What the hell is ADD?
[00:34.71]My friends say I should act my age
[00:36.75]What's my age again? What's my age again?
[00:42.72]Then later on, on the drive home
[00:45.78]I called her mom from a pay phone
[00:48.80]I said I was the cops and your husband's in jail
[00:51.85]The state looks down on sodomy
[00:54.52]And that's about the time that bitch hung up on me
[00:57.88]Nobody likes you when you're twenty-three
[01:01.03]And are still more amused by prank phone calls
[01:03.88]What the hell is call ID?
[01:05.27]My friends say I should act my age
[01:07.26]What's my age again? What's my age again?
[01:32.88]And that's about the time she walked away from me
[01:36.28]Nobody likes you when you're twenty-three
[01:39.37]And you still act like you're in freshman year
[01:42.25]What the hell is wrong with me?
[01:43.59]My friends say I should act my age
[01:45.64]What's my age again? What's my age again?
[01:46.89]That's about the time that she broke up with me
[01:50.05]No one should take themselves so seriously
[01:53.13]With many years ahead to fall in line
[01:55.99]Why would you wish that on me?
[01:57.41]I never want to act my age
[01:59.55]What's my age again? What's my age again?
[02:15.00]What's my age again?
